subject: Exclusive Summer Sale Starts Now!
body: Dear valued customer, We are excited to announce our Exclusive Summer Sale, starting today! Enjoy up to 50% off on selected summer styles like swimwear, sandals, and sunglasses. Don't miss this opportunity to refresh your wardrobe for the season. Visit our store or shop online to explore the latest trends and hottest deals. Hurry, limited stock available! Happy shopping!
